  367| function LobbyService:Join(player: Player, padId: number): string?
  368| 	local q = queue
  369| 	if not q or not inLobby(player) then
  370| 		return nil
  371| 	end
  372| 	local before = LobbyQueue.padOf(q, player.UserId)
  373| 	local ok = LobbyQueue.join(q, padId, player.UserId)
  374| 	if not ok then
  375| 		return if before == padId then q.pads[padId].squadId else nil
  376| 	end
  377| 	-- Put them physically on the pad so the position poll agrees (DevHook / scripted joins).
  378| 	if built and built.pads[padId] then
  379| 		local rec = built.pads[padId]
  380| 		local onIt = false
  381| 		local root = rootOf(player)
  382| 		if root then
  383| 			local d = root.Position - rec.part.Position
  384| 			onIt = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude <= LobbyConfig.PadRadius
  385| 		end
  386| 		if not onIt then
  387| 			pivot(player, CFrame.new(rec.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)))
  388| 		end
  389| 	end
  390| 	count("lobby_joins")
  391| 	syncSquadAttrs()
  392| 	if before then
  393| 		padChanged(before, q.pads[before].squadId)
  394| 	end
  395| 	padChanged(padId, q.pads[padId].squadId)
  396| 	renderBoard()
  397| 	broadcast()
  398| 	return q.pads[padId].squadId
  399| end
